purpose: Nineteenth-pass official and first-party verification for six less-repeated Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction records, current first-party operator or service pages, Companies House records, CQC records and official local-authority routes are promoted. Search snippets, directory-only claims and mirrored regulatory data are not promoted.
method.current_status_policy: A current website, service page, active company or regulated location can verify identity or activity but does not prove executed lease terms, current occupational rights, legal completion or exact parcel geometry.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.address: David Ethan House, 715 North Circular Road, London, NW2 7AH
